name: gpt2_ordinal
arch: gpt2: a pre-trained decoder-only transformer language model (12 layers, 12 heads per layer, d_model 768, d_head 64, d_mlp 3072, vocabulary 50257; pre-LayerNorm blocks: resid += attn(ln1(resid)); resid += mlp(ln2(resid)); logits = ln_f(resid) @ W_U; learned absolute position embeddings; GELU).

domain.text: Each prompt is a short phrase that ends in a number n written in digits (one token). x[:, 0] = n; x[:, 1] = which of the 4 phrase templates (0: "It was the <n>"; 1: "This is the <n>"; 2: "He finished the <n>"; 3: "Then on the <n>"). Roles: num = end = the number's position (the last token).

context: The prompts end in a number; the answer tokens are the English ordinal suffixes.

answer.short: GPT-2 small continues a number with its ordinal suffix: st / nd / rd / th by the last digit, with th for 11, 12, 13.
